storyline.real: Ralf Schumacher starts from pole and leads the first 19 laps, his tyres graining in the first stint. He stops on lap 20 and keeps his front tyres; Michael stops a lap later and comes out ahead. Ralf changes only the rears again at his second stop and loses time in traffic. He finishes second, 0.784 s behind his brother, with Montoya third.
storyline.headline: Ralf beats his brother to the flag in Montreal

hidden.label: Win without a lap managing the tyres

eras.briefing: Montreal, 2003. You run Ralf Schumacher's Williams from pole, leading after 17 laps, 1.0 s ahead of your brother's Ferrari and with Montoya 8.7 s further back. Your tyres are graining. Michael will stop a lap after you. Keep him behind and win.
